name: mirage
text: Thanks, that's exactly the case I need. Today the app is meant to take a bet off the list after a 'no one is selling' result. It should come back only if Novig's price moves by more than 1 cent, or after 2 hours. If yours came back sooner, either the price moved just past that band or a new list from GitHub re-added it, and I can't tell which yet. Your phone saves its report about every 20 minutes. The next one will have a NOFILL line for each of those bets, with the listed price, how old the ask was and the order result. I'll read it and fix the path that re-lists them. If you can, note which bets they were (team and line) so I can find them quickly.
